name: Tomorrowland Winter
description: Ski week with Tomorrowland stages in Alpe d'Huez
price: n/a (7-day and 4-day packages and single festival passes)
details:
Seventh edition of the winter edition of Tomorrowland: a week of skiing and electronic music stages on the slopes and in the resort. Packages include accommodation, a lift pass and festival access; 7-day packages went on sale 3 Oct 2026, 4-day packages and standalone tickets on 10 Oct 2026.

Line-up not announced yet. The official site could not be read (JS only), the dates come from music press (edmidentity, weraveyou, djmag).
